info.title: ChronoAI CMS / NyxID publishing service
info.description: Service transport uses Bearer or signed propagated authority. Browser CMS transport uses the existing same-origin session plus Origin/CSRF; do not expose service tokens in browser storage. Business rules and response DTOs are shared; no account or default connection fallback.

get.summary: Read authorized content pointers and states. Search and counts use the authorized revision; counts ignore status but respect articleId, language and search. Unknown, cross-owner or invisible articleId returns an empty result. draft means a creator revision distinct from live and pending submission; submitted means pending only. Translation metadata requires access to both articles and a currently authorized or successfully published historical source revision; it never grants historical body access.
